Devtools Update Log

25.12.0

New

  1. Mini Programs now support adjusting the navigation bar title position; the IDE adds enumeration values center and left for predictive text.

  2. The webview component adds a loadingStyle attribute; the IDE supports code prediction.

  3. Mini Programs add custom event communication APIs: removeCustomEvent and setCustomEvent; the IDE supports code prediction.

  4. Mini Programs support injecting custom APIs into the host app for persistent callbacks.

  5. Mini Programs support two-way communication between the webview component and embedded src pages.

  6. Mini Program UI component library adds the components Modal and List.

Optimization

  1. The IDE now supports predictive text for the hearder and src attributes of the WebView component.

  2. Additional API predictive text templates have been added to the IDE.

  3. Optimized the runtime framework for WeChat Mini Programs to improve its adaptability to delayed operations on iOS systems.

Fix

  1. Fixed an issue where initializing the WebView component with an invalid value would block subsequent page updates to the src attribute.

25.9.0

New

  1. The success callback of the current network API now includes the isConnectVPN field to indicate whether the current device is connected to a VPN (Minimum version: 25.9.0).

Optimization

  1. The Mini Program IDE plugin has removed the judgment for non-Chinese and non-English directories, continuously improving the development experience for Mini Program developers.

25.6.0

New

  1. Added H5 Mini Program online template.

Optimization

  1. Optimized converter experience, optimized real-device debugging experience.

25.3.0

New

  1. The experience of the Mini Program converter is optimized. The local resource image link can be used in the MASS file.

24.12.0

New

  1. The emulator supports setting the logo setTabBarBadge/removeTabBarBadge in the upper right corner of the tabbar. The IDE supports code association.
  2. The simulator supports the function of listening to the onKeyboardHeightChange/offKeyboardHeightChange when the keyboard height changes. The IDE supports the association of related codes.
  3. The shell type can be configured in the shell Mini Program.
  4. The simulator supports the function of obtaining system settings getSystemSetting. The IDE supports the association of related codes.
  5. The setClipboardData/getClipboardData clipboard capability is added to the simulator. The IDE supports code association.
  6. The simulator supports the conversion between the ArrayBuffer object and the Base64 character string base64ToArrayBuffer/arrayBufferToBase64. The IDE supports related code association.
  7. Multi-language translation of dsl Mini Programs is supported.

Optimization

  1. The user experience of importing an offline simulator is optimized. When importing a simulator, the system checks whether the simulator version matches the corresponding operating system type.
  2. Optimize the New Project UI and usage process.
  3. Optimize the packaging experience of development tools on low-performance machines.
  4. Optimize the compatibility of the development tool with high-level CSS features during compilation and packaging. Now, high-level CSS syntax such as inset is supported.

Fix

  1. Fixed an issue where there is a possibility that a new window does not respond when a project is created on the Mac operating system.
  2. The ES5 gasket becomes invalid when the development tool is compiled and packaged.

24.9.0

New

  1. IDE newly supports npm package management capability
  2. The simulator has added the ability to support chooseVideo, and the IDE supports related coding Lenovo
  3. IDE adds the ability to associate full-screen playback configuration items
  4. IDE adds support for VideoContext.stop
  5. The component library adds image, stepper, dialog, steps, sticky, tab and other components
  6. The simulator now supports permission control interfaces ma.deauthorize and ma.cancelAuthorize, and the IDE supports related coding associations.

Optimization

  1. Optimize the UX style of the simulator interface and optimize the menu item information structure
  2. Improve the compatibility between IDE manual packaging and system automatic packaging operations
  3. Optimize the accuracy of the information given after an unknown exception occurs during wired debugging, and optimize the interface interaction effect.
  4. Reduce the frequency of packaging failures caused by compilation resource release delays in low-performance scenarios

24.6.0

New

  1. The simulator adds a new exit miniprogram interface ma.exitMiniProgram, and the IDE supports related coding associations
  2. The simulator has added support for Bluetooth pairing capability, and the IDE supports related coding Lenovo
  3. IDE adds real machine debugging capability
  4. IDE newly supports custom buried points API coding association
  5. Added progress, radio, icon, cell, checkbox and other components to the component library

Optimization

  1. Optimize the usage experience and style of the input component
  2. Optimize the user experience of the IDE integrated Mini Program management platform
  3. Optimize the exception handling experience during the emulator startup exception process
  4. The document supplements some basic component sample codes

Fix

  1. Fix the packaging exception that occurs when repeated packaging in DSL Mini Program subcontracting scenarios
  2. Repair the style distortion of some components of the Mini Program management platform

24.3.0

New

  1. Added the ability to log in, and added new APIs to the simulator: ma.getAuthCode, ma.getOpenUserInfo, and the IDE supports related API coding associations

Fix

  1. Fixed the problem of probabilistic loss of configuration files when H5 Mini Program resources are used in extreme scenarios.
  2. Fixed the issue where the converter reports invalid address of the API document being converted

Optimization

  1. Optimize the use experience of the development tool suite and add more code associations and sample codes
  2. Supports simulator window size adjustment to optimize debugging experience

23.12.0

New

  1. The simulator has added a new log reporting API, and the IDE supports related API coding associations.
  2. The simulator adds Data Prefetch API, and the IDE supports related API coding Lenovo
  3. The simulator and compiler support the skeleton screen effect
  4. Added IDE light theme interface adaptation
  5. Added simulator support for map components and APIs
  6. The simulator supports data cache encrypted storage
  7. The simulator now supports small programs to configure startup parameters.

Fix

  1. Fix the exception to saving prompt when IDE does not install the simulator.
  2. Fixed the problem of abnormal configuration file reading under no build conversion
  3. Fixed the problem of abnormal packaging files during rapid repeated packaging.
  4. Fix the abnormal prompt when the simulator is not installed on IOS
  5. Fixed the problem of UX distortion in English prompts on the conversion interface

Optimization

  1. Optimize IDE dark theme UX
  2. Optimize the processing flow in the direct packaging scenario of unconverted projects and optimize the prompt information

23.9.0

New

  1. The simulator and converter support recording function
  2. Update IDE developer tools to support viewing logs
  3. The simulator and converter support RecordManager, as well as recording functions such as starting recording and stopping recording, and event callback related APIs

Fix

  1. Fix the problem of abnormal packaging of IDE on Mac machine
  2. Fixed the problem of abnormal configuration file under no build conversion
  3. Fix the problem that the plug-in cannot be loaded normally in the cache exception scenario.
  4. Fix the problem that the custom navigation bar set by the simulator does not take effect

23.6.0

New

  1. The simulator and converter support the FileSystemManager file manager, as well as writeFile, unlink, readFile and other file management related APIs
  2. The simulator and converter support loading user-defined font files
  3. The simulator and converter now support DownloadTask. Developers can check the progress of download tasks and abort download tasks.
  4. Update the IDE to connect to the management service and support one-stop IDE (Mini Program Saas networking)
  5. The simulator and converter have added the internationalization capabilities of showModal and picker components.

23.3.0

New

  1. IDE supports multi-language capabilities
  2. Coding association supports internationalization
  3. The compilation engine supports incremental compilation
